method: CFBD closing lines (DraftKings, else the first book) for 2024-25 regular-season games with an FBS side, joined to ESPN box scores. Per team-game, regulars over the team's previous three games by usage share (QB >= 50% of pass attempts, runner >= 25% of carries, receiver >= 15% of receptions); a regular absent from the box is missing. Closing home spread = strength per team-season + points per share x (home missing share - away), held out on odd/even games. Tackle share as a defender's measure and a QB yards-per-attempt term did not help and are not used.
